sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. Petitioners, who are permanent residents of Shahabad, are allegedly carrying on the business of supply drinking water in cans from their RO water units to the public of Shahabad.

According to the petitioners, necessary license has been issued to them by the City Municipal Council of Shahabad and the premises in which they have been carrying on business is installed with electricity meters.

The RR number of the petitioners' electricity meters are - 6136288944, 8179, 2749619062,
2710179362 and 6573179827.
4.

It appears that based on the complaint of respondent No.5 addressed to respondent No.3 vide Annexure - M dated 23.02.2022, supply of electricity to the petitioners' RO Unit was disconnected and it is under these circumstances, the petitioners are before this Court.
5. Perusal of Annexure - M would go to show that respondent No.5 has issued the communication dated NC: 2026:KHC-K:2487 HC-KAR 23.02.2022 addressed to respondent No.3 informing respondent No.3 that the petitioners are carrying on the business of water supply from their RO units without BIS Certificate, issued by the competent authority.
Considering the said communication at Annexure - M, respondent No.3 allegedly has disconnected electricity connection to the petitioners' RO Unit.

Respondent No.5 is the competent authority to take action against the petitioners under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and instead of taking any action against the petitioners for having allegedly violated the statutory provisions by not obtaining the BIS certificate of the competent authority, respondent No.5 appears to have requested respondent No.3 to disconnect electricity connection to petitioners' RO unit.

In my considered opinion, based on such a request, respondent No.3 could not have disconnected electricity connection to the petitioners' RO unit and it is for respondent No.5 to take appropriate action against the petitioners, if they are found to have violated the statutory requirements and have been carrying on business.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2487 HC-KAR 6.

Under the circumstances, the writ petition is partly allowed directing respondent No.3 to consider the representation of the petitioners at Annexure - L for restoration of electricity supply to their meters and pass appropriate orders on the same as expeditiously as possible but not later than a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

Sd/-
(S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE DN List No.: 1 Sl No.: 44/CT:
